The act of ovulation through, or by means of, one's anus.
Not ovulatory; characterized by anovulation (a lack of ovulation).
a contraceptive in the form of a pill containing estrogen and progestin to inhibit ovulation and so prevent conception
Critical lack of oxygen in blood; severe hypoxaemia.
Relating to, or exhibiting, anoxaemia.
abnormally low oxygen content in arterial blood
relating to or marked by abnormally little oxygen in arterial blood
severe hypoxia; absence of oxygen in inspired gases or in arterial blood or in the tissues
A condition in which a body tissue or an environment is severely or totally deprived of oxygen; severe hypoxia.
relating to or marked by a severe deficiency of oxygen in tissues or organs
Suffering from a reduced supply of oxygen.
Lacking oxygen.
anoxia resulting from defective oxygenation of the blood in the lungs
A period of time (e.g. in Earth's history) when large expanses of ocean are depleted of dissolved oxygen.
In an anoxic way; without oxygen.
A biological response triggered by a lack of oxygen in which an organism takes in water and becomes turgid and immobile; possibly a form of cryptobiosis.
Of or pertaining to anoxybiosis.
That does not involve the production of oxygen
A form of photosynthesis, employed by certain bacteria, in which oxygen is not produced.
